name: List All Property Attachments
description: Returns all attachments associated with a property

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by the unique identifier of the property. All GET requests must include a filter for [PropertyId] or [CreatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[CreatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter attachments created at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [PropertyId] or [CreatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The name given to describe the attachment

responseFields.name: data[].ContentType
responseFields.description: The content type of the attachment. An example content type is a photo or a PDF.

responseFields.name: data[].CreatedAt
responseFields.description: The date and time the attachment was created by an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].EntityId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the attachment

responseFields.name: data[].URL
responseFields.description: The link to download the file in the attachment

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
